company.name: Capitol AI
company.shortDescription: Capitol AI uses AI to create compelling narratives from data, aiding research, analysis, and content creation.
company.description: Capitol AI combines artificial intelligence with storytelling to transform how people research, analyze, and consume information. The platform allows users to input prompts in natural language, which it then uses to search for and craft compelling narratives from data. Capitol AI is designed for various applications, including research, work, and play, making it a versatile tool for creating impactful content. The service is utilized by professionals such as journalists, CEOs, and lobbyists to generate persuasive stories quickly and efficiently.

Additionally, the company focuses on generating easy-to-understand graphs of large data sets, supporting research, analysis, and content creation through advanced data visualization and relationship mapping.
